method: Streamed OpenAI-compatible calls, temperature 0. TTFT = request start to first content/reasoning token; prefill tok/s = uncached prompt_tokens / TTFT; decode tok/s = (completion_tokens - 1) / (last - first token), counts from server usage. Speed sweep: fresh nonce first in every prompt (no prefix-cache hits), ignore_eos+min_tokens forces the full length, 1 discarded warmup, median of reps. Other clients' in-flight requests checked before every sweep call. Quality-run speed is incidental (varying prompts), not a sweep.
